verdict.rationale: CrewAI's task/flow/crew orchestration model supports building agents that iterate over many items programmatically, and a documented community example shows exactly this — an agent bulk-categorizing, drafting, and auto-deleting many emails in an inbox (crewai-comm-1). However, there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated bulk/batch-processing API (e.g., a 'run for each item' or batch endpoint) in the evidence pack, only sequential/hierarchical single-task execution concepts. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API or 'for-each' primitive in official docs, independent benchmarks of bulk-scale runs, guardrails/rate-limit guidance for large batch jobs.
